The amber garden trial found no change in recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.
The ivory harbor trial found a change in recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
In the invented learning-gardens records, what do guided-session trials report about change in learner recall?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the public synthetic fixture (fixture-001.json)
- Reports a guided-session trial outcome on learner recall

## Exclusion criteria
- Any record not present in the supplied fixture

## Query log
- 2026-10-07 | invented-index | supplied fixture records (no live backend search; entirely invented domain) | 2 hits

## Screening
- amber (Lumen, 2024): included
- ivory (Vale, 2024): included

## Notes
Claim/source pairs and synthesis wording are preserved verbatim from the fixture for deterministic integrity evaluation.
The amber garden trial found no change in recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial found a change in recall (Vale, 2024).
